domain: All integers m>=7 and all theta in [theta_m, pi/2], with a fully labelled (m+1)-by-(m+2) unit-rhombic grid and guard row j=m+1. The continuous path, full pair bounds, cover-radius estimate, and slack formulas are proved analytically; exact integer/quadratic-surd controls check every displacement vector at m=7,8,12,24 and the endpoint ledger.
